title: Benyola v. Central Florida Presbytery (three complaints)
disposition_detail: The SJC found each of the three complaints (Case Nos. 2022-17, 2022-18, and 2022-19) administratively out of order and incapable of being put in order because Mr. Benyola was no longer a member of any PCA congregation and thus lacked standing; the decision was approved 23-0 on March 2, 2023.
first_summary: The SJC found three complaints by Peter Benyola against Central Florida Presbytery administratively out of order because Benyola was no longer a member of any PCA congregation and lacked standing. The SJC approved the decision 23-0.
